- 纯黑帧是防止未定义 GRAM 花屏的显示保护。
- 纯黑帧不是开机动画，不包含 Logo、文字、状态或进度。
- LVGL 的“正在准备”仍然是首个业务画面。
- 产品启动验收必须检查无花屏、无旧问候动画、无板级 idle 页面。

89: int lv_nuttx_fbdev_set_file(lv_display_t * disp, const char * file)
90: {
91:     int ret;
92:     LV_ASSERT(disp && file);
93:     lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc = lv_display_get_driver_data(disp);
94: 
95:     if(dsc->fd >= 0) close(dsc->fd);
96: 
97:     /* Open the file for reading and writing*/
98: 
99:     dsc->fd = open(file, O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
100:     if(dsc->fd < 0) {
101:         LV_LOG_ERROR("Error: cannot open framebuffer device");
102:         return -errno;
103:     }
104:     LV_LOG_USER("The framebuffer device was opened successfully");
105: 
106:     if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)&dsc->vinfo)) < 0) {
107:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIOGET_VIDEOINFO) failed: %d", errno);
108:         ret = -errno;
109:         goto errout;
110:     }
111: 
112:     LV_LOG_USER("VideoInfo:");
113:     LV_LOG_USER("      fmt: %u", dsc->vinfo.fmt);
114:     LV_LOG_USER("     xres: %u", dsc->vinfo.xres);
115:     LV_LOG_USER("     yres: %u", dsc->vinfo.yres);
116:     LV_LOG_USER("  nplanes: %u", dsc->vinfo.nplanes);
117: 
118:     if((ret = fbdev_get_pinfo(dsc->fd, &dsc->pinfo)) < 0) {
119:         goto errout;
120:     }
121: 
122:     lv_color_format_t color_format = fb_fmt_to_color_format(dsc->vinfo.fmt);
123:     if(color_format == LV_COLOR_FORMAT_UNKNOWN) {
124:         goto errout;
125:     }
126: 
127:     dsc->mem = mmap(NULL, dsc->pinfo.fblen, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE,
128:                     MAP_SHARED | MAP_FILE, dsc->fd, 0);
129:     if(dsc->mem == MAP_FAILED) {
130:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIOGET_PLANEINFO) failed: %d", errno);
131:         ret = -errno;
132:         goto errout;
133:     }
134: 
135:     uint32_t w = dsc->vinfo.xres;
136:     uint32_t h = dsc->vinfo.yres;
137:     uint32_t stride = dsc->pinfo.stride;
138:     uint32_t data_size = h * stride;
139:     lv_draw_buf_init(&dsc->buf1, w, h, color_format, stride, dsc->mem, data_size);
140: 
141:     /* double buffer mode */
142: 
143:     bool double_buffer = dsc->pinfo.yres_virtual == (dsc->vinfo.yres * 2);

145:         if((ret = fbdev_init_mem2(dsc)) < 0) {

150:     }

153:     lv_display_set_color_format(disp, color_format);
154:     lv_display_set_render_mode(disp, LV_DISPLAY_RENDER_MODE_DIRECT);
155:     lv_display_set_resolution(disp, dsc->vinfo.xres, dsc->vinfo.yres);

176: static void display_refr_timer_cb(lv_timer_t * tmr)
177: {
178:     lv_display_t * disp = lv_timer_get_user_data(tmr);
179:     lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc = lv_display_get_driver_data(disp);
180:     struct pollfd pfds[1];
181: 
182:     lv_memzero(pfds, sizeof(pfds));
183:     pfds[0].fd = dsc->fd;
184:     pfds[0].events = POLLOUT;
185: 
186:     /* Query free fb to draw */
187: 
188:     if(poll(pfds, 1, 0) < 0) {
189:         return;
190:     }
191: 
192:     if(pfds[0].revents & POLLOUT) {
193:         _lv_display_refr_timer(tmr);
194:     }
195: }

197: static void flush_cb(lv_display_t * disp, const lv_area_t * area, uint8_t * color_p)
198: {
199:     lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc = lv_display_get_driver_data(disp);
200: 
201:     /* Skip the non-last flush */
202: 
203:     if(!lv_display_flush_is_last(disp)) {
204:         lv_display_flush_ready(disp);
205:         return;
206:     }
207: 
208:     if(dsc->mem == NULL ||
209:        area->x2 < 0 || area->y2 < 0 ||
210:        area->x1 > (int32_t)dsc->vinfo.xres - 1 || area->y1 > (int32_t)dsc->vinfo.yres - 1) {
211:         lv_display_flush_ready(disp);
212:         return;
213:     }
214: 
215: #if defined(CONFIG_FB_UPDATE)
216:     /*May be some direct update command is required*/
217:     int yoffset = disp->buf_act == disp->buf_1 ?
218:                   0 : dsc->mem2_yoffset;
219: 
220:     /* Join the areas to update */
221:     lv_area_t dirty_area;
222:     lv_display_get_dirty_area(disp, &dirty_area);
223: 
224:     struct fb_area_s fb_area;
225:     fb_area.x = dirty_area.x1;
226:     fb_area.y = dirty_area.y1 + yoffset;
227:     fb_area.w = lv_area_get_width(&dirty_area);
228:     fb_area.h = lv_area_get_height(&dirty_area);
229:     if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIO_UPDATE, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)&fb_area)) < 0) {
230:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIO_UPDATE) failed: %d", errno);
231:     }
232: #endif
233: 
234:     /* double framebuffer */
235: 
236:     if(dsc->mem2 != NULL) {
237:         if(disp->buf_act == disp->buf_1) {
238:             dsc->pinfo.yoffset = 0;
239:         }
240:         else {
241:             dsc->pinfo.yoffset = dsc->mem2_yoffset;
242:         }
243: 
244:         if(ioctl(dsc->fd, FBIOPAN_DISPLAY, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t) & (dsc->pinfo))) < 0) {
245:             LV_LOG_ERROR("ioctl(FBIOPAN_DISPLAY) failed: %d", errno);
246:         }
247:     }
248:     lv_display_flush_ready(disp);
249: }

267: 
268:     return LV_COLOR_FORMAT_UNKNOWN;
269: }
270: 
271: static int fbdev_get_pinfo(int fd, FAR struct fb_planeinfo_s * pinfo)
272: {
273:     if(ioctl(fd, FBIOGET_PLANEINFO, (unsigned long)((uintptr_t)pinfo)) < 0) {
274:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ERROR: ioctl(FBIOGET_PLANEINFO) failed: %d", errno);
275:         return -errno;
276:     }
277: 
278:     LV_LOG_USER("PlaneInfo (plane %d):", pinfo->display);
279:     LV_LOG_USER("    mem: %p", pinfo->fbmem);
280:     LV_LOG_USER("    fblen: %zu", pinfo->fblen);
281:     LV_LOG_USER("   stride: %u", pinfo->stride);
282:     LV_LOG_USER("  display: %u", pinfo->display);
283:     LV_LOG_USER("      bpp: %u", pinfo->bpp);
284: 
285:     return 0;
286: }
287: 
288: static int fbdev_init_mem2(lv_nuttx_fb_t * dsc)
289: {
290:     struct fb_planeinfo_s pinfo;
291:     void * phy_mem1;
292:     void * phy_mem2;
293: 
294:     int ret;
295: 
296:     /* Get display[0] planeinfo */
297:     lv_memzero(&pinfo, sizeof(pinfo));
298:     pinfo.display = dsc->pinfo.display;
299:     if((ret = fbdev_get_pinfo(dsc->fd, &pinfo)) < 0) return ret;
300:     phy_mem1 = pinfo.fbmem;
301: 
302:     /* Get display[1] planeinfo */
303:     lv_memzero(&pinfo, sizeof(pinfo));
304:     pinfo.display = dsc->pinfo.display + 1;
305:     if((ret = fbdev_get_pinfo(dsc->fd, &pinfo)) < 0) return ret;
306:     phy_mem2 = pinfo.fbmem;
307: 
308:     lv_uintptr_t offset = (lv_uintptr_t)phy_mem2 - (lv_uintptr_t)phy_mem1;
309:     bool is_consecutive = offset == 0;
310: 
311:     /* Check bpp */
312: 
313:     if(pinfo.bpp != dsc->pinfo.bpp) {
314:         LV_LOG_WARN("mem2 is incorrect");
315:         return -EINVAL;
316:     }
317: 
318:     /* Check the buffer address offset,
319:      * It needs to be divisible by pinfo.stride
320:      */
321: 
322:     if((offset % dsc->pinfo.stride) != 0) {
323:         LV_LOG_WARN("It is detected that buf_offset(%" PRIuPTR ") "
324:                     "and stride(%d) are not divisible, please ensure "
325:                     "that the driver handles the address offset by itself.",
326:                     offset, dsc->pinfo.stride);
327:     }
328: 
329:     /* Calculate the address and yoffset of mem2 */
330: 
331:     if(is_consecutive) {
332:         dsc->mem2_yoffset = dsc->vinfo.yres;
333:         offset = dsc->vinfo.yres * pinfo.stride;
334:     }
335:     else {
336:         dsc->mem2_yoffset = offset / dsc->pinfo.stride;
337:     }
338: 
339:     uint32_t fblen = is_consecutive ? pinfo.fblen / 2 : pinfo.fblen;
340:     void * mem2 = mmap(NULL, fblen, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE, MAP_SHARED | MAP_FILE, dsc->fd, offset);
341:     if(mem2 == MAP_FAILED) {
342:         LV_LOG_ERROR("ERROR: mmap failed: %d, offset: %" PRIuPTR, errno, offset);
343:         return -errno;
344:     }
345:     dsc->mem2 = mem2;
346: 
347:     LV_LOG_USER("Use of %sconsecutive mem2 = %p, yoffset = %" LV_PRIu32, is_consecutive ? "" : "non-", dsc->mem2,
348:                 dsc->mem2_yoffset);
349: 
350:     return 0;
351: }

362:             /* Unmap the framebuffer memory */

365:         }

已按旧开机动画的同步显示原则重新实现，不再依赖固定延时。

**根因**

旧动画路径是同步执行：

```text
清空 framebuffer
整帧 push
绘制动画
整帧 push
函数返回
```

每次 `gc9d01_push()` 都会同步完成完整的 `51200 bytes` 面板传输。因此面板显示的始终是已经完整提交的帧。

之前的实现虽然先提交了黑帧，但随后执行的是：

```text
开背光
velasight_autostart()
```

而 `velasight_autostart()` 只通过 `task_create()` 创建异步任务。开背光时，LVGL 实际还没有完成：

```text
lv_init()
打开 /dev/fb0
打开 /dev/fb1
创建组件
绘制首帧
FBIO_UPDATE
```

这使黑帧和 LVGL 首帧之间仍存在异步接管窗口。

**新的启动时序**

现在完整时序为：

```text
board_early_initialize()
      ↓
立即将 GPIO25 拉低，关闭共享背光
      ↓
GC9D01 面板初始化
      ↓
注册 /dev/fb0 和 /dev/fb1
      ↓
向两块屏幕各同步 push 一帧 RGB565 纯黑
      ↓
创建 VelaSight 任务，但继续保持背光关闭
      ↓
LVGL 打开两个 framebuffer
      ↓
创建两套完整组件树
      ↓
填充“正在准备”业务快照
      ↓
invalidate 两个根 screen
      ↓
分别调用 lv_refr_now(fb0) 和 lv_refr_now(fb1)
      ↓
等待两个 FBIO_UPDATE 和完整 GC9D01 push 返回
      ↓
调用 bk7258_display_reveal()
      ↓
开启共享背光
```

这与旧动画的核心行为一致：只有完整可显示帧已经到达面板 GRAM 后，才允许用户看到屏幕。

**关键修改**

`board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_boot.c`

- 在最早的 `board_early_initialize()` 中关闭背光。
- 不再等到面板初始化阶段才控制 GPIO25。
- 消除系统早期初始化阶段 GPIO25 浮动或默认高电平的窗口。

`board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_bringup.c`

- 黑帧提交后不再立即开启背光。
- 新增一次性 `bk7258_display_reveal()`。
- 只有 LVGL 主动通知双屏首帧已完成后才开启背光。
- 增加启动日志：

```text
velasight: LVGL first frames ready, backlight on
```

`app/velasight/vs_display.c`

- 首次渲染时显式 invalidate 两个根 screen。
- 分别同步执行：

```c
lv_refr_now(display->panel[VS_STATUS_PANEL].display);
lv_refr_now(display->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display);
```

- `lv_refr_now()` 会直接进入 NuttX framebuffer backend。
- backend 调用 `FBIO_UPDATE`。
- GC9D01 驱动同步完成整帧 push 后才返回。
- 两块屏幕均完成后调用 `bk7258_display_reveal()`。
- reveal 只执行一次，后续刷新恢复正常 LVGL timer 驱动方式。

**为什么没有使用固定延时**

固定延时无法保证：

- 不同构建大小下 LVGL 初始化耗时一致。
- 两个 framebuffer 打开耗时一致。
- CJK 字体和组件树首次绘制耗时一致。
- QSPI 整帧传输已经完成。

现在等待的是实际的两次 `FBIO_UPDATE` 返回，因此交接条件是确定的，不依赖猜测 `100 ms`、`300 ms` 或更长延时。

**文档**

已更新：

```text
docs/plans/VELASIGHT_UI_DESIGN_INSTRUCTION.md
docs/plans/VELASIGHT_MCU_APP_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md

```

文档已明确：

- GPIO25 必须在 `board_early_initialize()` 中拉低。
- 黑帧完成后先启动隐藏状态下的 LVGL。
- LVGL 必须同步完成双屏首帧。
- 两次 `FBIO_UPDATE` 返回后才允许开启背光。
- 启动门禁需要观察 `LVGL first frames ready, backlight on` 日志。

293: int vs_display_open(struct vs_display_s **display)
294: {
295:   struct vs_display_s *state;
296:   lv_nuttx_dsc_t descriptor;
297:   int ret;
298: 
299:   if (display == NULL)
300:     return -EINVAL;
301: 
302:   state = calloc(1, sizeof(*state));
303:   if (state == NULL)
304:     return -ENOMEM;
305: 
306:   lv_init();
307:   lv_nuttx_dsc_init(&descriptor);
308:   descriptor.fb_path = "/dev/fb0";
309:   lv_nuttx_init(&descriptor, &state->nuttx);
310:   if (state->nuttx.disp == NULL)
311:     {
312:       free(state);
313:       return -ENODEV;
314:     }
315: 
316:   ret = vs_panel_init(&state->panel[VS_STATUS_PANEL], state->nuttx.disp);
317:   if (ret < 0)
318:     goto fail_status;
319: 
320:   state->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display = lv_nuttx_fbdev_create();
321:   if (state->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display == NULL ||
322:       lv_nuttx_fbdev_set_file(state->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display,
323:                               "/dev/fb1") < 0)
324:     {
325:       ret = -ENODEV;
326:       goto fail_content;
327:     }
328: 
329:   ret = vs_panel_init(&state->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL],
330:                       state->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display);
331:   if (ret < 0)
332:     goto fail_content;
333: 
334:   *display = state;
335:   return 0;
336: 
337: fail_content:
338:   if (state->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display != NULL)
339:     lv_display_delete(state->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display);
340: fail_status:
341:   lv_nuttx_deinit(&state->nuttx);
342:   free(state);
343:   return ret;
344: }
345: 
346: int vs_display_render(struct vs_display_s *display,
347:                       const struct vs_ui_snapshot_s *snapshot)
348: {
349:   if (display == NULL || snapshot == NULL)
350:     return -EINVAL;
351: 
352:   /* fb1 is the physical left content display; fb0 is the physical right
353:    * status display. */
354:   vs_render_content(&display->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL], snapshot);
355:   vs_render_status(&display->panel[VS_STATUS_PANEL], snapshot);
356: 
357:   if (!display->revealed)
358:     {
359:       /* Match the old synchronous boot animation's hand-off: both complete
360:        * frames must reach panel GRAM before the shared backlight is enabled.
361:        * lv_refr_now() executes each framebuffer's FBIO_UPDATE synchronously. */
362: 
363:       lv_obj_invalidate(display->panel[VS_STATUS_PANEL].screen);
364:       lv_obj_invalidate(display->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].screen);
365:       lv_refr_now(display->panel[VS_STATUS_PANEL].display);
366:       lv_refr_now(display->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display);
367: #ifdef CONFIG_LVX_USE_DEMO_CONTEST2026_264_VELASIGHT
368:       bk7258_display_reveal();
369: #endif
370:       display->revealed = true;
371:     }
372:   display->waiting = snapshot->progress_kind == VS_PROGRESS_WAIT;
373:   snprintf(display->wait_meta, sizeof(display->wait_meta), "%s",
374:            snapshot->status_meta);
375:   if (!display->waiting)
376:     {
377:       display->wait_phase = 0;
378:       display->wait_next_ms = 0;
379:     }
380:   if (display->revealed)
381:     lv_timer_handler();
382:   return 0;
383: }
384: 
385: void vs_display_tick(struct vs_display_s *display)
386: {
387:   if (display != NULL)
388:     {
389:       uint32_t now = vs_display_now_ms();
390: 
391:       if (display->waiting &&
392:           (display->wait_next_ms == 0 ||
393:            (int32_t)(now - display->wait_next_ms) >= 0))
394:         {
395:           static const char *const phases[] = {".", "..", "...", ""};
396:           char meta[VS_TEXT_LONG];
397: 
398:           snprintf(meta, sizeof(meta), "%s%s", display->wait_meta,
399:                    phases[display->wait_phase]);
400:           vs_set_label(display->panel[VS_STATUS_PANEL].meta,
401:                        meta);
402:           display->wait_phase = (display->wait_phase + 1) % 4;
403:           display->wait_next_ms = now + 350;
404:         }
405:       lv_timer_handler();
406:     }
407: }
408: 
409: void vs_display_close(struct vs_display_s *display)
410: {
411:   if (display == NULL)
412:     return;
413: 
414:   if (display->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display != NULL)
415:     lv_display_delete(display->panel[VS_CONTENT_PANEL].display);
416:   lv_nuttx_deinit(&display->nuttx);
417:   lv_deinit();
418:   free(display);
419: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_agent_config.c
3:  *
4:  * Hand the API key and endpoint stored in flash to ai_agent, by writing the
5:  * config file it already reads at start-up.
6:  *
7:  * Why it is done this way
8:  * ----------------------
9:  * packages/ai_agent is a public repository this project must not modify, so
10:  * the agent cannot be taught to read our key-value store directly.  It does,
11:  * however, already persist its own configuration as a flat JSON object
12:  * (src/infra/config_store.c, AGENT_CONFIG_FILE) and load it on start; and its
13:  * LLM router keeps backend slots under "llm_backend_<n>" whose value is
14:  * itself a JSON object (src/llm/llm_router.c).  Writing that file before the
15:  * agent runs is therefore the supported path: the agent starts already
16:  * configured, with no patch and no key compiled into the image.
17:  *
18:  * What this replaces: packages/ai_agent/include/agent_secrets.h, a header
19:  * copied into the public tree with the key in it, which put the key into
20:  * every .bin built from that tree.
21:  *
22:  * The file is only written when both a key and a host are stored, and only if
23:  * the data directory is on a real filesystem -- in the nsh configuration
24:  * /mnt is not mounted at all, and a missing mount is not an error worth
25:  * printing on every boot.
26:  *
27:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
28:  ****************************************************************************/
29: 
30: /****************************************************************************
31:  * Included Files
32:  ****************************************************************************/
33: 
34: #include <nuttx/config.h>
35: 
36: #include <errno.h>
37: #include <stdio.h>
38: #include <string.h>
39: #include <sys/stat.h>
40: 
41: #include "bk7258_kvdb.h"
42: 
43: /****************************************************************************
44:  * Pre-processor Definitions
45:  ****************************************************************************/
46: 
47: #ifdef CONFIG_EXAMPLES_AI_AGENT_VELA_DATA_DIR
48: #  define AGENT_DATA_DIR CONFIG_EXAMPLES_AI_AGENT_VELA_DATA_DIR
49: #else
50: #  define AGENT_DATA_DIR "/mnt/ai_agent"
51: #endif
52: 
53: #define AGENT_CONFIG_DIR  AGENT_DATA_DIR "/config"
54: #define AGENT_CONFIG_FILE AGENT_CONFIG_DIR "/config.json"
55: 
56: /* Defaults for the parts of a backend slot that are not worth a key of their
57:  * own.  MiMo is HTTPS and the OpenAI-compatible path; model falls back to the
58:  * only one that still exists (mimo-v2-flash and -omni went away 2026-06-30).
59:  */
60: 
61: #define AGENT_DEFAULT_PATH  "/v1/chat/completions"
62: #define AGENT_DEFAULT_PORT  "443"
63: #define AGENT_DEFAULT_MODEL "mimo-v2.5"
64: 
65: /****************************************************************************
66:  * Public Functions
67:  ****************************************************************************/
68: 
69: void bk7258_kvdb_seed_agent_config(void)
70: {
71:   char key[513];
72:   char host[128];
73:   char model[64];
74:   FILE *f;
75: 
76:   if (bk7258_kvdb_get(BK7258_KVDB_KEY_LLM_KEY, key, sizeof(key)) <= 0 ||
77:       bk7258_kvdb_get(BK7258_KVDB_KEY_LLM_HOST, host, sizeof(host)) <= 0)
78:     {
79:       return;
80:     }
81: 
82:   if (bk7258_kvdb_get(BK7258_KVDB_KEY_LLM_MODEL, model, sizeof(model)) <= 0)
83:     {
84:       strlcpy(model, AGENT_DEFAULT_MODEL, sizeof(model));
85:     }
86: 
87:   /* mkdir the tree.  The agent does this itself as well, but it does it when
88:    * it starts, which is after this runs.
89:    */
90: 
91:   mkdir(AGENT_DATA_DIR, 0700);
92:   mkdir(AGENT_CONFIG_DIR, 0700);
93: 
94:   f = fopen(AGENT_CONFIG_FILE, "w");
95:   if (f == NULL)
96:     {
97:       /* Almost always "no filesystem there yet", which is the normal state of
98:        * the nsh configuration.  Not worth a line on every boot.
99:        */
100: 
101:       return;
102:     }
103: 
104:   /* One flat object, exactly the shape config_store.c writes.  The backend
105:    * slot's value is a JSON object *as a string*, so its quotes are escaped;
106:    * that nesting is the router's format, not a mistake.
107:    */
108: 
109:   fprintf(f,
110:           "{\"llm_router_profile\":\"kvdb\","
111:           "\"llm_backend_0\":\""
112:           "{\\\"host\\\":\\\"%s\\\","
113:           "\\\"path\\\":\\\"%s\\\","
114:           "\\\"port\\\":\\\"%s\\\","
115:           "\\\"api_key\\\":\\\"%s\\\","
116:           "\\\"model\\\":\\\"%s\\\","
117:           "\\\"priority\\\":0,"
118:           "\\\"cost_tier\\\":1}\"}",
119:           host, AGENT_DEFAULT_PATH, AGENT_DEFAULT_PORT, key, model);
120: 
121:   fclose(f);
122: 
123:   printf("kvdb: ai_agent configured from flash (host=%s model=%s, "
124:          "key %zu bytes)\n", host, model, strlen(key));
125: }

已查明并修复日志中的 SoftAP 退出错误。

**问题原因**

关键日志是：

```text
velasight: network STA ifdown failed: -110
```

`-110` 是 `-ETIMEDOUT`。发生流程为：

```text
SoftAP 页面
-> 长按返回
-> 进入网络切换页
-> 停止配网服务
-> 停止 DHCP
-> wapi_set_ifdown("wlan0")
-> 驱动返回 -ETIMEDOUT
-> 原实现把清理超时当成切换失败
-> 进入错误页
```

这里的 `ifdown` 是退出当前网络角色的清理动作。驱动已经开始停止接口，但没有在等待时间内返回成功。原代码将这个超时直接作为致命错误，因此误显示错误页。它不是 AP 配置失败，也不是 STA 连接失败。

**网络切换修复**

修改了 `app/velasight/vs_network.c`：

- AP 退出时，`wapi_set_ifdown()` 返回 `-ETIMEDOUT` 时记录日志但继续清理。
- STA 退出时同样处理 `-ETIMEDOUT`。
- `-ENODEV` 和清理阶段的 `-ETIMEDOUT` 都按幂等清理处理。
- 真正的启动、连接、DHCP、地址配置和配网服务错误仍然会进入错误页。
- 每个网络失败点都会记录具体步骤和 errno，例如：

```text
STA连接 (-110)
STA获取地址 (-110)
AP启动 (-22)
AP地址 (-5)
AP DHCP (-12)
AP配网服务 (-16)
```

退出 SoftAP 后，预期流程现在是：

```text
停止 SoftAP
-> ifdown 超时仅记录 warning
-> 继续切换 STA
-> STA 连接或 DHCP 成功
-> 返回主页
```

而不是直接进入页面 19。

**错误页改进**

错误页不再只显示：

```text
出了问题
请重试或返回上一页
```

现在会显示明确原因，例如：

```text
拍照失败 (-5)
短按返回
```

```text
AI未返回回答 (-74)
短按返回
```

```text
STA获取地址 (-110)
短按重试或返回
```

已区分并覆盖：

- 拍照失败
- 拍照没有返回照片
- AI 没有返回回答
- 语音处理失败
- 社交会话启动失败
- 社交会话操作失败
- 社交摘要为空
- 社交记录整理失败
- STA 配置、接口、连接、DHCP 失败
- AP 配置、接口、启动、IPv4、掩码、DHCP、配网服务失败
- 保存 Wi-Fi 配置失败
- DHCP 停止失败
- 网络模式切换失败
- 通用 errno 原因，包括超时、设备不可用、参数无效、配置不存在、数据格式错误、内存不足等

错误页的返回目标也仍然保留，返回后会回到触发错误的正确页面，而不是固定跳转到错误页面或错误的历史页。

**拍照提问主页**

`VS_PAGE_HISTORY_BLANK` 现在作为产品主页使用：

- 左屏上层标题：`拍照提问`
- 左屏中层：

```text
拍一张照片
然后直接问我
```

- 左屏下层确认动作改为：

```text
拍照
```

这样不会再出现上层和下栏同时重复显示两个“拍照提问”。

拍照按钮仍然进入原来的拍照状态页：

```text
拍照提问主页
-> 短按拍照
-> 正在拍照
-> 请说话
-> 正在思考
-> 回答建议
```

**主页状态栏**

主页左屏下栏新增三个独立状态项：

```text
Wi+ / Wi-
B+ / B-
A+ / A-
```

含义：

- `Wi+`：STA 或 SoftAP 已就绪
- `Wi-`：当前没有可用网络
- `B-`：当前没有电池 ADC 支持，按需求显示无电池状态
- `B+`：预留给后续电池检测
- `A+`：KVDB 中存在 API key 和 API host
- `A-`：API key 或 host 尚未配置

有效状态使用绿色显示，无效或未支持状态使用灰色显示。状态项只出现在拍照提问主页，不会覆盖其他页面的软键。

**新增板级接口**

增加：

```c
bool bk7258_ai_config_ready(void);
```

它只检查 `llm.key` 和 `llm.host` 是否存在，不会显示或打印 API key 内容。

45:   uint32_t  generation;
46:   velasight_prov_saved_cb_t on_saved;
47:   void     *cb_arg;
48: };
49: 
50: static struct vp_server_s g_server =
51: {
52:   .listenfd = -1,
53:   .state    = VP_STATE_IDLE,
54: };
55: 
56: static pthread_mutex_t g_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
57: 
58: /* Request and response buffers are static because only one connection is
59:  * served at a time and 6KB of thread stack on this part is not free.
60:  */
61: 
62: static char g_request[VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS + VP_HTTP_MAX_BODY + 1];
63: static char g_response[VP_HTTP_RESPONSE_MAX];
64: 
65: static int vp_write_all(int fd, const char *data, size_t len)
66: {
67:   size_t sent = 0;
68: 
69:   while (sent < len)
70:     {
71:       ssize_t n = write(fd, data + sent, len - sent);
72: 
73:       if (n < 0)
74:         {
75:           if (errno == EINTR)
76:             {
77:               continue;
78:             }
79: 
80:           return -errno;
81:         }
82: 
83:       if (n == 0)
84:         {
85:           return -EPIPE;
86:         }
87: 
88:       sent += (size_t)n;
89:     }
90: 
91:   return 0;
92: }
93: 
94: /****************************************************************************
95:  * Name: vp_read_request
96:  *
97:  * Description:
98:  *   Read until the headers plus the declared body have arrived, the cap is
99:  *   reached or the deadline passes.  Returns the total length, or negative on
100:  *   error.  A client that opens a connection and says nothing costs one
101:  *   timeout, not the service.
102:  *
103:  ****************************************************************************/
104: 
105: static int vp_read_request(int fd, struct vp_http_request_s *req)
106: {
107:   size_t total = 0;
108:   int waited = 0;
109: 
110:   for (; ; )
111:     {
112:       struct pollfd pfd;
113:       ssize_t n;
114:       int ret;
115: 
116:       ret = vp_http_parse(g_request, total, req);
117:       if (ret == 0)
118:         {
119:           if (req->action != VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE ||
120:               total >= req->header_len + req->content_length)
121:             {
122:               return (int)total;
123:             }
124:         }
125:       else if (ret != -EAGAIN)
126:         {
127:           return ret;
128:         }
129: 
130:       if (total >= sizeof(g_request) - 1)
131:         {
132:           return -E2BIG;
133:         }
134: 
135:       pfd.fd = fd;
136:       pfd.events = POLLIN;
137:       pfd.revents = 0;
138:       ret = poll(&pfd, 1, VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS);
139:       if (ret < 0)
140:         {
141:           if (errno == EINTR)
142:             {
143:               continue;
144:             }
145: 
146:           return -errno;
147:         }
148: 
149:       if (ret == 0)
150:         {
151:           waited += VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS;
152:           if (waited >= VP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)
153:             {
154:               return -ETIMEDOUT;
155:             }
156: 
157:           continue;
158:         }
159: 
160:       n = read(fd, g_request + total, sizeof(g_request) - 1 - total);
161:       if (n < 0)
162:         {
163:           if (errno == EINTR)
164:             {
165:               continue;
166:             }
167: 
168:           return -errno;
169:         }
170: 
171:       if (n == 0)
172:         {
173:           /* Peer closed.  Whatever arrived is all there will be, so let the
174:            * parser decide between "incomplete" and "answerable".
175:            */
176: 
177:           if (vp_http_parse(g_request, total, req) == 0 &&
178:               (req->action != VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE ||
179:                total >= req->header_len + req->content_length))
180:             {
181:               return (int)total;
182:             }
183: 
184:           return -ECONNRESET;
185:         }
186: 
187:       total += (size_t)n;
188:     }
189: }
190: 
191: /****************************************************************************
192:  * Name: vp_handle
193:  *
194:  * Description:
195:  *   Serve one connection.  Sets *saved when credentials were persisted and
196:  *   *save_status to 0 or the negative errno of a failed save, so the caller can
197:  *   notify the application only after the socket is gone.
198:  *
199:  ****************************************************************************/
200: 
201: static void vp_handle(int fd, bool *saved, int *save_status,
202:                       uint32_t *generation)
203: {
204:   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s cred;
205:   struct vp_http_request_s req;
206:   size_t len = 0;
207:   int ret;
208: 
209:   *saved = false;
210:   *save_status = 0;
211: 
212:   ret = vp_read_request(fd, &req);
213:   if (ret < 0)
214:     {
215:       if (ret == -E2BIG)
216:         {
217:           len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 431,
218:                                     "请求过大。");
219:         }
220:       else
221:         {
222:           /* Nothing usable arrived; answering a client that already gave up
223:            * is not worth a second syscall.
224:            */
225: 
226:           return;
227:         }
228:     }
229:   else if (req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE)
230:     {
231:       len = vp_http_form_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), NULL);
232:     }
233:   else if (req.action == VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT)
234:     {
235:       len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), req.status,
236:                                req.status == 404 ? "页面不存在。" :
237:                                req.status == 405 ? "不支持该请求方法。" :
238:                                req.status == 413 ? "提交内容过大。" :
239:                                req.status == 415 ? "提交格式不受支持。" :
240:                                req.status == 411 ? "缺少 Content-Length。" :
241:                                                    "请求无法解析。");
242:     }
243:   else
244:     {
245:       memset(&cred, 0, sizeof(cred));
246:       ret = vp_form_parse(g_request + req.header_len, req.content_length,
247:                           &cred);
248:       if (ret < 0)
249:         {
250:           /* No detail about which field failed and no echo of what was typed:
251:            * the notice has to be useful to the person at the phone without
252:            * repeating a passphrase back over an open network.
253:            */
254: 
255:           len = vp_http_form_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response),
256:                                   "SSID 需 1-32 字节，密码需留空或 8-63 字节，"
257:                                   "请检查后重试。");
258:           if (len > 0)
259:             {
260:               /* Reuse the form page body but answer 400, so a client that
261:                * checks the status still learns the submit failed.
262:                */
263: 
264:               len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 400,
265:                                         "SSID 需 1-32 字节，密码需留空或 "
266:                                         "8-63 字节。");
267:             }
268:         }
269:       else
270:         {
271:           cred.generation = vp_store_next_generation(g_server.store_path);
272:           ret = vp_store_save(g_server.store_path, &cred);
273:           if (ret < 0)
274:             {
275:               *saved = false;
276:               *save_status = ret;
277:               len = vp_http_status_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response), 500,
278:                                         "写入持久存储失败，凭据未保存。");
279:             }
280:           else
281:             {
282:               *saved = true;
283:               *save_status = 0;
284:               *generation = cred.generation;
285:               len = vp_http_saved_page(g_response, sizeof(g_response),
286:                                        cred.ssid, cred.generation,
287:                                        cred.open_network);
288:             }
289:         }
290:     }
291: 
292:   if (len > 0)
293:     {
294:       ret = vp_write_all(fd, g_response, len);
295:       if (ret < 0)
296:         {
297:           /* Keep AP mode available when the phone disconnected before it
298:            * received the result page.  The record itself was already saved.
299:            */
300:           if (*saved)
301:             {
302:               *saved = false;
303:             }
304:           *save_status = ret;
305:         }
306:     }
307: }
308: 
309: static void *vp_thread(void *arg)
310: {
311:   (void)arg;
312: 
313:   for (; ; )
314:     {
315:       struct pollfd pfd;
316:       uint32_t generation = 0;
317:       int save_status = 0;
318:       bool saved = false;
319:       bool stopping;
320:       int fd;
321:       int ret;
322: 
323:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
324:       stopping = g_server.stopping;
325:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
326:       if (stopping)
327:         {
328:           break;
329:         }
330: 
331:       pfd.fd = g_server.listenfd;
332:       pfd.events = POLLIN;
333:       pfd.revents = 0;
334: 
335:       /* Polling rather than blocking in accept(): stop() then needs no signal
336:        * and no socket shutdown trick that may or may not wake accept on a
337:        * given stack.
338:        *
339:        * This requires CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG on NuttX, which the Kconfig
340:        * depends on.  Without it TCP_BACKLOG events never fire, POLLIN on a
341:        * listening socket is unreachable, and accept() blocks with no timeout
342:        * at all -- measured on the board as a service that reported
343:        * "listening" and then answered nothing.
344:        */
345: 
346:       ret = poll(&pfd, 1, VP_ACCEPT_POLL_MS);
347:       if (ret < 0)
348:         {
349:           if (errno == EINTR)
350:             {
351:               continue;
352:             }
353: 
354:           break;
355:         }
356: 
357:       if (ret == 0)
358:         {
359:           continue;
360:         }
361: 
362:       fd = accept(g_server.listenfd, NULL, NULL);
363:       if (fd < 0)
364:         {
365:           if (errno == EINTR || errno == ECONNABORTED)
366:             {
367:               continue;
368:             }
369: 
370:           break;
371:         }
372: 
373:       printf("provision_web: accepted client\n");
374:       vp_handle(fd, &saved, &save_status, &generation);
375: 
376:       /* Close before notifying.  The application is expected to leave SoftAP
377:        * from the callback, and doing that with the response still in flight is
378:        * what makes a successful save look like a failed submit on the phone.
379:        */
380: 
381:       shutdown(fd, SHUT_RDWR);
382:       close(fd);
383: 
384:       if (saved)
385:         {
386:           pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
387:           g_server.generation = generation;
388:           pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
389:         }
390: 
391:       if (saved || save_status < 0)
392:         {
393:           if (g_server.on_saved != NULL)
394:             {
395:               g_server.on_saved(save_status, generation, g_server.cb_arg);
396:             }
397:         }
398: 
399:       if (saved && g_server.one_shot)
400:         {
401:           break;
402:         }
403: 
404:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
405:       stopping = g_server.stopping;
406:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
407:       if (stopping)
408:         {
409:           break;
410:         }
411:     }
412: 
413:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
414:   if (g_server.listenfd >= 0)
415:     {
416:       close(g_server.listenfd);
417:       g_server.listenfd = -1;
418:     }
419: 
420:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_FINISHED;
421:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
422:   return NULL;
423: }
424: 
425: /* Caller holds g_lock. */
426: 
427: static void vp_reap_locked(void)
428: {
429:   if (g_server.state == VP_STATE_FINISHED)
430:     {
431:       pthread_t thread = g_server.thread;
432: 
433:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
434:       pthread_join(thread, NULL);
435:       pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
436:       g_server.state = VP_STATE_IDLE;
437:     }
438: }
439: 
440: int velasight_provisioning_start(
441:     const struct velasight_prov_config_s *config)
442: {
443:   struct velasight_prov_config_s cfg;
444:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
445:   pthread_attr_t attr;
446:   uint16_t port;
447:   int one = 1;
448:   int fd;
449:   int ret;
450: 
451:   memset(&cfg, 0, sizeof(cfg));
452:   if (config != NULL)
453:     {
454:       cfg = *config;
455:     }
456: 
457:   if (cfg.store_path != NULL &&
458:       strlen(cfg.store_path) >= VP_STORE_PATH_MAX)
459:     {
460:       return -ENAMETOOLONG;
461:     }
462: 
463:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
464:   vp_reap_locked();
465:   if (g_server.state != VP_STATE_IDLE)
466:     {
467:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
468:       return -EALREADY;
469:     }
470: 
471:   port = cfg.port != 0 ? cfg.port :
472:          (uint16_t)CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT;
473: 
474:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
475:   if (fd < 0)
476:     {
477:       ret = -errno;
478:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
479:       return ret;
480:     }
481: 
482:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_REUSEADDR, &one, sizeof(one));
483: 
484:   memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
485:   addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
486:   addr.sin_port        = htons(port);
487:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_ANY);
488: 
489:   if (bind(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0 ||
490:       listen(fd, 2) < 0)
491:     {
492:       ret = -errno;
493:       close(fd);
494:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
495:       return ret;
496:     }
497: 
498:   g_server.listenfd   = fd;
499:   g_server.stopping   = false;
500:   g_server.one_shot   = cfg.one_shot;
501:   g_server.generation = 0;
502:   g_server.on_saved   = cfg.on_saved;
503:   g_server.cb_arg     = cfg.cb_arg;
504:   snprintf(g_server.store_path, sizeof(g_server.store_path), "%s",
505:            cfg.store_path != NULL ? cfg.store_path :
506:            CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE);
507:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_RUNNING;
508: 
509:   pthread_attr_init(&attr);
510:   pthread_attr_setstacksize(&attr, VP_THREAD_STACK);
511:   ret = pthread_create(&g_server.thread, &attr, vp_thread, NULL);
512:   pthread_attr_destroy(&attr);
513:   if (ret != 0)
514:     {
515:       close(fd);
516:       g_server.listenfd = -1;
517:       g_server.state = VP_STATE_IDLE;
518:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
519:       return -ret;
520:     }
521: 
522:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
523: 
524:   printf("provision_web: listening on 0.0.0.0:%u, store %s\n",
525:          (unsigned)port, g_server.store_path);
526:   return 0;
527: }
528: 
529: int velasight_provisioning_stop(void)
530: {
531:   pthread_t thread;
532: 
533:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
534:   vp_reap_locked();
535:   if (g_server.state != VP_STATE_RUNNING)
536:     {
537:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
538:       return -EALREADY;
539:     }
540: 
541:   g_server.stopping = true;
542:   thread = g_server.thread;
543: 
544:   /* Called from the saved callback, which runs on the listener thread: joining
545:    * ourselves would deadlock, so only ask the loop to end and let the normal
546:    * exit path close the socket.  A later stop() from the application reaps it.
547:    */
548: 
549:   if (pthread_equal(thread, pthread_self()))
550:     {
551:       pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
552:       return 0;
553:     }
554: 
555:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
556:   pthread_join(thread, NULL);
557: 
558:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
559:   g_server.state = VP_STATE_IDLE;
560:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
561:   return 0;
562: }
563: 
564: bool velasight_provisioning_is_running(void)
565: {
566:   bool running;
567: 
568:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
569:   running = g_server.state == VP_STATE_RUNNING;
570:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
571:   return running;
572: }
573: 
574: uint32_t velasight_provisioning_generation(void)
575: {
576:   uint32_t generation;
577: 
578:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
579:   generation = g_server.generation;
580:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
581:   return generation;
582: }
583: 
584: int velasight_provisioning_load_from(
585:     const char *path, struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *out)
586: {
587:   if (path == NULL || out == NULL)
588:     {
589:       return -EINVAL;
590:     }
591: 
592:   return vp_store_load(path, out);
593: }
594: 
595: int velasight_provisioning_load(
596:     struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *out)
597: {
598:   char path[VP_STORE_PATH_MAX];
599: 
600:   pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lock);
601:   if (g_server.store_path[0] != '\0')
602:     {
603:       snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s", g_server.store_path);
604:     }
605:   else
606:     {
607:       snprintf(path, sizeof(path), "%s", CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE);
608:     }
609: 
610:   pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lock);
611: 
612:   return velasight_provisioning_load_from(path, out);
613: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * app/provisioning_web/include/velasight_provisioning.h
3:  *
4:  * AP-mode provisioning web entry.  The application switches the radio into
5:  * SoftAP itself, calls velasight_provisioning_start(), and gets told when a
6:  * phone has submitted credentials.  This service never touches the Wi-Fi
7:  * role: it does not associate, does not run wapi, does not start DHCPD and
8:  * does not switch back to STA.  Owning both the HTTP page and the radio would
9:  * make it impossible for the application to decide when the network may drop.
10:  *
11:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
12:  ****************************************************************************/
13: 
14: #ifndef __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_INCLUDE_VELASIGHT_PROVISIONING_H
15: #define __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_INCLUDE_VELASIGHT_PROVISIONING_H
16: 
17: #include <stdbool.h>
18: #include <stddef.h>
19: #include <stdint.h>
20: 
21: #ifdef __cplusplus
22: extern "C"
23: {
24: #endif
25: 
26: /* IEEE 802.11 SSID length, and the WPA2 passphrase range.  An empty password
27:  * means an open network, which is the only reason 0 is legal.
28:  */
29: 
30: #define VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX 32
31: #define VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MIN  8
32: #define VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX  63
33: 
34: /* Where the record lives when the caller passes no path.  On SD-NAND, so it
35:  * survives a reset; /mnt itself is pseudo-filesystem and /mnt/ram is a PSRAM
36:  * ramdisk, neither of which would.
37:  *
38:  * Every component fits 8.3 because that SD-NAND is VFAT without long-name
39:  * support (CONFIG_FAT_LFN is not set): a "velasight" directory or a
40:  * "wifi-provision.bin" file is rejected outright with -EINVAL.
41:  */
42: 
43: #ifndef CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE
44: #  define CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_STORE "/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin"
45: #endif
46: 
47: #ifndef CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT
48: #  define CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT 80
49: #endif
50: 
51: struct velasight_prov_credentials_s
52: {
53:   char     ssid[VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX + 1];
54:   char     password[VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX + 1];
55:   uint32_t generation;   /* Monotonic save counter, first save is 1 */
56:   bool     open_network; /* Password is empty */
57: };
58: 
59: /* Called after the success page has been written and the connection closed,
60:  * never before: the application is expected to leave SoftAP from here, and
61:  * doing that mid-response is what makes a phone show "submit failed" for a
62:  * save that actually happened.
63:  *
64:  * status is 0 on success or a negative errno.  Credentials are deliberately
65:  * absent -- read them with velasight_provisioning_load() so a passphrase does
66:  * not travel through every callback that only wanted the notification.
67:  */
68: 
69: typedef void (*velasight_prov_saved_cb_t)(int status, uint32_t generation,
70:                                           void *arg);
71: 
72: struct velasight_prov_config_s
73: {
74:   uint16_t                  port;       /* 0 selects the built-in default */
75:   bool                      one_shot;   /* Stop after one accepted submit */
76:   const char               *store_path; /* NULL selects the built-in path */
77:   velasight_prov_saved_cb_t on_saved;   /* May be NULL */
78:   void                     *cb_arg;
79: };
80: 
81: /****************************************************************************
82:  * Name: velasight_provisioning_start
83:  *
84:  * Description:
85:  *   Bind the HTTP port and start the listener thread.  Returns 0, -EALREADY
86:  *   if it is already running, or a negative errno.  A NULL config means all
87:  *   defaults.  The config is copied, so the caller may free it.
88:  *
89:  ****************************************************************************/
90: 
91: int velasight_provisioning_start(
92:     const struct velasight_prov_config_s *config);
93: 
94: /****************************************************************************
95:  * Name: velasight_provisioning_stop
96:  *
97:  * Description:
98:  *   Close the listener and join the thread.  Returns 0, or -EALREADY when
99:  *   nothing was running.  Safe to call from the saved callback.
100:  *
101:  ****************************************************************************/
102: 
103: int velasight_provisioning_stop(void);
104: 
105: bool velasight_provisioning_is_running(void);
106: 
107: /* Saves observed in this process; 0 before the first one.  Persisted saves
108:  * from earlier boots are counted by the generation inside the record.
109:  */
110: 
111: uint32_t velasight_provisioning_generation(void);
112: 
113: /****************************************************************************
114:  * Name: velasight_provisioning_load
115:  *
116:  * Description:
117:  *   Read the stored credentials.  Returns 0, -ENOENT when nothing has been
118:  *   provisioned, -EBADMSG when the record is corrupt, or a negative errno.
119:  *

6:  * call velasight_provisioning_start() from their own long-lived task instead:
7:  * the listener runs on a pthread, and a pthread does not outlive the task that
8:  * created it, so a command that started the service and returned would take
9:  * the service with it.  That is why this command stays in the foreground.

30: static void provision_usage(void)

33:          " path\n"
34:          "\n"
35:          "  run       serve the provisioning page until Ctrl-C.  port\n"
36:          "            defaults to %d.  --one-shot returns after the first\n"
37:          "            accepted save.\n"
38:          "  selftest  submit a canned form over loopback and verify it was\n"
39:          "            persisted.  Overwrites the stored record with a test\n"
40:          "            network; needs no phone.\n"
41:          "  show      print the stored network, never the passphrase\n"
42:          "  path      print the store path\n"

45:          "SoftAP first (see docs/WiFi使用说明.md) and switch back afterwards.\n"
46:          "The page is plain HTTP with no authentication, so run it only while\n"
47:          "provisioning.\n",
48:          CONFIG_VELASIGHT_PROVISION_PORT);
49: }

92:    * into the serial log, which is the one place it is guaranteed to be read by
93:    * someone who did not need it.

201: static int provision_exchange(const char *request, char *reply,
202:                               size_t replylen)

204:   struct sockaddr_in addr;
205:   struct timeval tv;
206:   size_t total = 0;
207:   int fd;
208: 
209:   fd = socket(AF_INET, SOCK_STREAM, 0);
210:   if (fd < 0)
211:     {
212:       return -errno;
213:     }
214: 
215:   tv.tv_sec  = 5;
216:   tv.tv_usec = 0;
217:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_RCVTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
218:   setsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_SNDTIMEO, &tv, sizeof(tv));
219: 
220:   memset(&addr, 0, sizeof(addr));
221:   addr.sin_family      = AF_INET;
222:   addr.sin_port        = htons(PROV_TEST_PORT);
223:   addr.sin_addr.s_addr = htonl(INADDR_LOOPBACK);
224: 
225:   if (connect(fd, (struct sockaddr *)&addr, sizeof(addr)) < 0)
226:     {
227:       int error = -errno;
228: 
229:       close(fd);
230:       return error;
231:     }
232: 
233:   if (write(fd, request, strlen(request)) < 0)
234:     {
235:       int error = -errno;
236: 
237:       close(fd);
238:       return error;
239:     }
240: 
241:   for (; ; )
242:     {
243:       ssize_t n = read(fd, reply + total, replylen - 1 - total);
244: 
245:       if (n <= 0)
246:         {
247:           break;
248:         }
249: 
250:       total += (size_t)n;
251:       if (total >= replylen - 1)
252:         {
253:           break;
254:         }
255:     }
256: 
257:   close(fd);
258:   reply[total] = '\0';
259:   return (int)total;
260: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * app/provisioning_web/vp_form.c
3:  *
4:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
5:  ****************************************************************************/
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <string.h>
10: 
11: #include "vp_form.h"
12: 
13: /* Long enough to tell "too long" from "just fits": the largest legal value is
14:  * a 63-byte passphrase, so a 64..126 byte submit is decoded and then rejected
15:  * on length, instead of arriving truncated to something legal.
16:  */
17: 
18: #define VP_FORM_VALUE_MAX 128
19: #define VP_FORM_NAME_MAX  32
20: 
21: static int vp_hexval(char c)
22: {
23:   if (c >= '0' && c <= '9')
24:     {
25:       return c - '0';
26:     }
27: 
28:   if (c >= 'a' && c <= 'f')
29:     {
30:       return c - 'a' + 10;
31:     }
32: 
33:   if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'F')
34:     {
35:       return c - 'A' + 10;
36:     }
37: 
38:   return -1;
39: }
40: 
41: int vp_url_decode(const char *src, size_t srclen, char *out, size_t outlen)
42: {
43:   size_t i = 0;
44:   size_t o = 0;
45: 
46:   if (src == NULL || out == NULL || outlen == 0)
47:     {
48:       return -EINVAL;
49:     }
50: 
51:   while (i < srclen)
52:     {
53:       unsigned char byte;
54: 
55:       if (src[i] == '%')
56:         {
57:           int hi;
58:           int lo;
59: 
60:           if (srclen - i < 3)
61:             {
62:               return -EINVAL;
63:             }
64: 
65:           hi = vp_hexval(src[i + 1]);
66:           lo = vp_hexval(src[i + 2]);
67:           if (hi < 0 || lo < 0)
68:             {
69:               return -EINVAL;
70:             }
71: 
72:           byte = (unsigned char)((hi << 4) | lo);
73:           i += 3;
74:         }
75:       else if (src[i] == '+')
76:         {
77:           byte = (unsigned char)' ';
78:           i++;
79:         }
80:       else
81:         {
82:           byte = (unsigned char)src[i];
83:           i++;
84:         }
85: 
86:       /* %00 would otherwise cut the value short and leave the rest of it
87:        * unexamined, which is how a validated string stops matching the bytes
88:        * that were actually submitted.
89:        */
90: 
91:       if (byte == 0)
92:         {
93:           return -EINVAL;
94:         }
95: 
96:       if (o + 1 >= outlen)
97:         {
98:           return -E2BIG;
99:         }
100: 
101:       out[o++] = (char)byte;
102:     }
103: 
104:   out[o] = '\0';
105:   return (int)o;
106: }
107: 
108: static size_t vp_strnlen(const char *s, size_t maxlen)
109: {
110:   size_t n = 0;
111: 
112:   while (n < maxlen && s[n] != '\0')
113:     {
114:       n++;
115:     }
116: 
117:   return n;
118: }
119: 
120: static bool vp_ssid_char_ok(char c)
121: {
122:   unsigned char u = (unsigned char)c;
123: 
124:   /* Control characters only: an SSID is arbitrary bytes on the air, and a
125:    * UTF-8 name has to survive.
126:    */
127: 
128:   return u >= 0x20 && u != 0x7f;
129: }
130: 
131: static bool vp_psk_char_ok(char c)
132: {
133:   unsigned char u = (unsigned char)c;
134: 
135:   /* A WPA2 passphrase is printable ASCII.  Anything else could not have been
136:    * typed into the router either.
137:    */
138: 
139:   return u >= 0x20 && u <= 0x7e;
140: }

142: int vp_credentials_validate(
143:     const struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
144: {
145:   size_t len;
146:   size_t i;
147: 
148:   if (cred == NULL)
149:     {
150:       return -EINVAL;
151:     }
152: 
153:   len = vp_strnlen(cred->ssid, sizeof(cred->ssid));
154:   if (len == 0 || len > VELASIGHT_PROV_SSID_MAX)
155:     {
156:       return -EINVAL;
157:     }
158: 
159:   for (i = 0; i < len; i++)
160:     {
161:       if (!vp_ssid_char_ok(cred->ssid[i]))
162:         {
163:           return -EINVAL;
164:         }
165:     }
166: 
167:   len = vp_strnlen(cred->password, sizeof(cred->password));
168:   if (len == 0)
169:     {
170:       /* The flag and the passphrase have to tell the same story, otherwise a
171:        * caller that trusts only one of them behaves differently from a caller
172:        * that trusts the other.
173:        */
174: 
175:       return cred->open_network ? 0 : -EINVAL;
176:     }
177: 
178:   if (cred->open_network)
179:     {
180:       return -EINVAL;
181:     }
182: 
183:   if (len < VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MIN || len > VELASIGHT_PROV_PSK_MAX)
184:     {
185:       return -EINVAL;
186:     }
187: 
188:   for (i = 0; i < len; i++)
189:     {
190:       if (!vp_psk_char_ok(cred->password[i]))
191:         {
192:           return -EINVAL;
193:         }
194:     }
195: 
196:   return 0;
197: }

199: int vp_form_parse(const char *body, size_t bodylen,
200:                   struct velasight_prov_credentials_s *cred)
201: {
202:   uint32_t generation;
203:   unsigned nfields = 0;
204:   bool have_ssid = false;
205:   bool have_psk = false;
206:   size_t pos = 0;
207: 
208:   if (body == NULL || cred == NULL)
209:     {
210:       return -EINVAL;
211:     }
212: 
213:   generation = cred->generation;
214:   memset(cred, 0, sizeof(*cred));
215:   cred->generation = generation;
216: 
217:   while (pos < bodylen)
218:     {
219:       char name[VP_FORM_NAME_MAX + 1];
220:       char value[VP_FORM_VALUE_MAX];
221:       const char *sep;
222:       const char *amp;
223:       size_t fieldlen;
224:       size_t namelen;
225:       int decoded;
226: 
227:       amp = memchr(body + pos, '&', bodylen - pos);
228:       fieldlen = amp != NULL ? (size_t)(amp - (body + pos)) : bodylen - pos;
229: 
230:       if (++nfields > VP_FORM_MAX_FIELDS)
231:         {
232:           return -E2BIG;
233:         }
234: 
235:       if (fieldlen == 0)
236:         {
237:           pos += 1;
238:           continue;
239:         }
240: 
241:       sep = memchr(body + pos, '=', fieldlen);
242:       if (sep == NULL)
243:         {
244:           /* "ssid" without a value is not an empty SSID, it is a body this
245:            * code does not understand.
246:            */
247: 
248:           return -EINVAL;
249:         }
250: 
251:       namelen = (size_t)(sep - (body + pos));
252:       decoded = vp_url_decode(body + pos, namelen, name, sizeof(name));
253:       if (decoded == -EINVAL)
254:         {
255:           return -EINVAL;
256:         }
257: 
258:       if (decoded < 0)
259:         {
260:           /* A name too long to be one of ours cannot be one of ours. */
261: 
262:           goto next;
263:         }
264: 
265:       if (strcmp(name, "ssid") != 0 && strcmp(name, "password") != 0)
266:         {
267:           goto next;
268:         }
269: 
270:       decoded = vp_url_decode(sep + 1, fieldlen - namelen - 1,
271:                               value, sizeof(value));
272:       if (decoded < 0)
273:         {
274:           return -EINVAL;
275:         }
276: 
277:       if (strcmp(name, "ssid") == 0)
278:         {
279:           if (have_ssid)
280:             {
281:               return -EINVAL;
282:             }
283: 
284:           have_ssid = true;
285:           if ((size_t)decoded >= sizeof(cred->ssid))
286:             {
287:               return -EINVAL;
288:             }
289: 
290:           memcpy(cred->ssid, value, (size_t)decoded + 1);
291:         }
292:       else
293:         {
294:           if (have_psk)
295:             {
296:               return -EINVAL;
297:             }
298: 
299:           have_psk = true;
300:           if ((size_t)decoded >= sizeof(cred->password))
301:             {
302:               return -EINVAL;
303:             }
304: 
305:           memcpy(cred->password, value, (size_t)decoded + 1);
306:         }
307: 
308: next:
309:       pos += fieldlen;
310:       if (pos < bodylen)
311:         {
312:           pos += 1; /* the '&' */
313:         }
314:     }
315: 
316:   if (!have_ssid)
317:     {
318:       return -EINVAL;
319:     }
320: 
321:   /* A form with no password field at all is how an open network is submitted
322:    * by a client that simply left the input out.
323:    */
324: 
325:   cred->open_network = cred->password[0] == '\0';

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * app/provisioning_web/vp_http.h
3:  *
4:  * The smallest HTTP surface that can serve one form and accept one submit.
5:  * Everything it does not recognise is refused with a status rather than
6:  * tolerated: this listener sits on an open SoftAP, so "be liberal in what you
7:  * accept" buys nothing and costs attack surface.
8:  *
9:  * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
10:  ****************************************************************************/
11: 
12: #ifndef __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_VP_HTTP_H
13: #define __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_VP_HTTP_H
14: 
15: #include <stdbool.h>
16: #include <stddef.h>
17: #include <stdint.h>
18: 
19: /* Request headers and body caps.  A provisioning form needs a few hundred
20:  * bytes; anything larger is a mistake or a probe.
21:  */
22: 
23: #define VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS 2048
24: #define VP_HTTP_MAX_BODY    512
25: 
26: /* Enough for the form page plus the largest status page. */
27: 
28: #define VP_HTTP_RESPONSE_MAX 4096
29: 
30: enum vp_http_action_e
31: {
32:   VP_HTTP_ACTION_PAGE = 0, /* GET / -- serve the form */
33:   VP_HTTP_ACTION_SAVE,     /* POST /save -- body is a form submit */
34:   VP_HTTP_ACTION_REJECT    /* answer with .status and close */
35: };
36: 
37: struct vp_http_request_s
38: {
39:   enum vp_http_action_e action;
40:   int                   status;         /* Only meaningful when REJECT */
41:   size_t                header_len;     /* Includes the blank line */
42:   size_t                content_length; /* 0 unless SAVE */
43: };
44: 
45: /****************************************************************************
46:  * Name: vp_http_parse
47:  *
48:  * Description:
49:  *   Parse whatever has arrived so far.  Returns -EAGAIN while the headers are
50:  *   incomplete and 0 once a decision has been made, with action saying what
51:  *   to do.  Rejections carry the status to answer with:
52:  *
53:  *     405  a method other than GET or POST
54:  *     404  an unknown path
55:  *     411  POST without Content-Length
56:  *     413  a body over VP_HTTP_MAX_BODY
57:  *     415  a submit that is not form-urlencoded
58:  *     431  headers over VP_HTTP_MAX_HEADERS
59:  *     400  anything malformed, including chunked bodies
60:  *
61:  ****************************************************************************/
62: 
63: int vp_http_parse(const char *buf, size_t len,
64:                   struct vp_http_request_s *req);
65: 
66: /****************************************************************************
67:  * Name: vp_html_escape
68:  *
69:  * Description:
70:  *   Escape &, <, >, " and ' for insertion into element text or an attribute.
71:  *   Returns the escaped length or -E2BIG.  The SSID comes from the network,
72:  *   so it is untrusted even though it is short.
73:  *
74:  ****************************************************************************/
75: 
76: int vp_html_escape(const char *in, char *out, size_t outlen);
77: 
78: /* Response builders.  Each returns the number of bytes written, or 0 when the
79:  * buffer is too small.  No password is ever part of a response body, which
80:  * the host tests assert directly rather than trust.
81:  */
82: 
83: size_t vp_http_form_page(char *buf, size_t buflen, const char *notice);
84: 
85: size_t vp_http_saved_page(char *buf, size_t buflen, const char *ssid,
86:                           uint32_t generation, bool open_network);
87: 
88: size_t vp_http_status_page(char *buf, size_t buflen, int status,
89:                            const char *message);
90: 
91: #endif /* __APP_PROVISIONING_WEB_VP_HTTP_H */

130:  * Description:
131:  *   Join the stored network and start the console service.
132:  *
133:  *   Must be called from a task and never from bring-up: association blocks on
134:  *   the CP and DHCP blocks on the network, and an AP that stops servicing the
135:  *   mailbox loses the heartbeat, after which the CP's 8-second watchdog resets
136:  *   the chip.  That is the same constraint that made kvdb_loader a task, so
137:  *   this is called from the end of it -- which also guarantees the credentials
138:  *   have already come back from flash.
139:  *
140:  ****************************************************************************/

142: void bk7258_net_autostart(void)
143: {
144:   FAR char *renew_argv[3];
145:   int tries;
146:   int ret;
147: 
148:   /* Association, from the credentials in the store.  -ENOENT means nobody has
149:    * configured a network yet, which is an ordinary state for a fresh board and
150:    * not worth a scary message.
151:    */
152: 
153:   ret = bk7258_kvdb_apply_wifi();

158:     }

167:   renew_argv[1] = (FAR char *)NET_IFNAME;
168:   renew_argv[2] = NULL;
169: 
170:   for (tries = 0; tries < NET_DHCP_TRIES; tries++)
171:     {
172:       usleep(NET_DHCP_GAP_MS * 1000);
173:

175:       if (ret < 0)

116: ## HTTP 表面
117: 
118: | 请求 | 响应 |
119: |---|---|
120: | `GET /`、`GET /index.html` | 200 表单页 |
121: | `POST /save`（`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`） | 200 成功页 / 400 校验失败 / 500 写盘失败 |
122: | 其他方法 | 405 |
123: | 其他路径 | 404 |
124: | 缺 `Content-Length` | 411 |
125: | body > 512 字节 | 413 |
126: | 非表单 Content-Type | 415 |
127: | 请求头 > 2048 字节 | 431 |
128: | `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` | 400 |
129: 
130: 读超时 5 秒，一次只服务一个连接，每个连接答完即关闭。成功页只回显经过 HTML 转义的
131: SSID；**密码永不回显、永不进日志**。
132: 
133: 校验规则：SSID 1–32 字节且不含控制字符；密码留空表示开放网络，否则必须 8–63 字节的
134: 可打印 ASCII。表单缺 `ssid` 直接 400；`ssid` 或 `password` 重复出现按歧义拒绝，不猜。
135: 
136: ## NAND 记录
137: 
138: 默认 `/mnt/sdnand/prov/wifi.bin`，固定 114 字节，小端：
139: 
140: | 偏移 | 长度 | 字段 |
141: |---|---|---|
142: | 0 | 4 | 魔数 `VSWP` |
143: | 4 | 2 | 版本，当前 1 |
144: | 6 | 2 | 标志位，bit0 = 开放网络 |
145: | 8 | 4 | generation |
146: | 12 | 1 | ssid_len，1..32 |
147: | 13 | 1 | psk_len，0 或 8..63 |
148: | 14 | 32 | SSID，补零 |
149: | 46 | 63 | 密码，补零 |
150: | 109 | 1 | 保留，必须 0 |
151: | 110 | 4 | CRC32（IEEE，覆盖 0..109） |
152: 
153: 落盘顺序是同目录的 `vpsave.tmp` → `fflush` → `fsync` → `close` → `rename` → `sync()`。
154: 若目标文件缺失但 scratch 是完整且 CRC 有效的记录，下一次读取会先将 scratch 提升为正式
155: 记录；损坏 scratch 按 `-EBADMSG` 拒绝，不会被提升。
156: 魔数、版本、两个长度、开放标志与 `psk_len` 的自洽性、补零区、保留字节和 CRC 逐项校验，
157: 任何一项不过按 `-EBADMSG` 处理，不做「尽力恢复」。
158: 
159: 只保留最新一份，提交即替换，generation 递增。凭据不镜像到 kvdb——需要的话由应用读出后
160: 自己写。
161: 
162: ## 三条平台约束（都是上板实测撞出来的）
163: 
164: 改动这三处之前先读这一节，否则会重现同样的故障：
165: 
166: 1. **`/mnt` 必须保持伪文件系统。** PSRAM ramdisk 挂在 `/mnt/ram`，不是 `/mnt`。
167:    NuttX 不允许在真实文件系统内部再挂载，`/mnt` 上挂了 littlefs 之后 SD-NAND 的
168:    `/mnt/sdnand` 会以 `-ENOTDIR` 挂载失败，持久存储静默消失。
169: 2. **`CONFIG_NET_TCPBACKLOG=y` 是必需项。** 没有它 listening socket 上不会有
170:    `POLLIN`，`accept()` 也无超时，可停止的监听线程无法实现；症状是打印了 listening
171:    之后什么都不回。本模块 Kconfig 已 `depends on` 它，配置错误会在编译期暴露。
172: 3. **SD-NAND 是不带长名的 VFAT。** `CONFIG_FAT_LFN` 未开，路径每一段必须符合 8.3。
173:    `velasight/`、`wifi-provision.bin` 都会被 `-EINVAL` 拒绝，把 `.tmp` 追加到
174:    `wifi.bin` 得到两个点也非法——所以临时文件是固定名 `vpsave.tmp`。主机测试会逐段
175:    校验默认路径的 8.3 合规性。
176: 
177: VFAT 上 `rename` 不是单步原子：NuttX 的 VFS 先 unlink 目标，FAT 的 `rename` 拒绝覆盖。
178: 所以存在「旧记录已删、新记录未就位」的极短窗口，此时读到 `-ENOENT`；读不到截断记录，
179: 因为长度和 CRC 都会拒绝。
180: 
181: ## 安全边界
182: 
183: - **服务是明文 HTTP 且无鉴权。** 热点覆盖内的任何设备都能提交。缓解手段：SoftAP 带
184:   WPA2 密码、只在配网期间开启、配完 `stop()`，或者用 `one_shot`。
185: - **密码在 NAND 上是明文。** VFAT 没有可信的权限模型，这颗芯片也没有已确认可用的设备
186:   密钥来源，所以不假装做静态加密。可控的部分是：不写日志、不回显、只走公共 API 读取。
187:   物理拿到 SD-NAND 就能读到密码。
188: - 不要把真实密码写进仓库、提交信息或测试日志。

387: ## 十、2026-08-17 复测：一处驱动缺陷已修，六处判据更新
388: 
389: > 本节与飞书《BK7258 AIDK 上板命令参考》第十节同步。全部来自当日实际执行输出。
390: 
391: ### 10.1 `agent_camera n>1` 只出一帧（已修）
392: 
393: 症状：第 0 帧正常，之后固定 `no frame within 5000 ms` → `FAILED (-110)`。
394: 
395: 已排除：WiFi（`ifdown wlan0` 后一样）、`tcp=`（不带也一样）、工作队列被占（`ps` 显示 `lpwork` 空闲）、应用（`poll → DQBUF → QBUF` 闭合，re-QBUF 无报错）。
396: 
397: 定责：在 `set_buf()` 加只统计 streaming 期间调用的 `set_buf_live`，实测 `set_buf_live=1 armed=0 encoding=0` —— 框架确实重新 arm 过，责任在驱动的编码 work。
398: 
399: 根因：`bk7258_camera_sw_jpeg_work()` 的三条提前返回（`!capturing || frame_buf == NULL || g_sw_jpeg == NULL`、`frame_buf_size == 0`、`jpeg_raw_ready < 0`）既不调 `capture_cb` 也不还回 `jpeg_buf_armed`，而 `frame_done()` 排入 work 前已清掉 arm，于是握手永久断开。
400: 
401: 修法：每条不完成 buffer 的出口都还回 arm（`priv->jpeg_buf_armed = priv->capturing;`）。
402: 
403: | 指标 | 改前 | 改后 |
404: |---|---|---|
405: | 交付帧（`n=8`） | 1，然后 `FAILED (-110)` | 8/8，`agent_camera: OK` |
406: | `set_buf_live` / `armed` | 1 / 0 | 8 / 1 |
407: | `sampler_skipped` | 0 | 67 |
408: 
409: 画质：`n=6 rec=6`，6/6 通过长度 + FNV-1a；1–5 帧 luma 113.1–113.3、Cr 127.5、R−B 0.57–0.72。
410: 
411: ### 10.2 `/dev/video1` 是软件编码器（15 帧确认）
412: 
413: `camera_preview 600 jpeg=40 jpegb64` 取 15 帧全部一致：luma 110.3–120.9、Cr 129.8–130.3、饱和 1.25–1.62%、结构逐帧相同（`E0,DB,DB,C0,C4×4,SOS@609`）、`rst=0`、无 DRI。640x480 的 `codec 570ms` 即软件编码在 XIP 上的代价。
414: 
415: ### 10.3 硬件采集通路（`CONFIG_BK7258_CAMERA_JPEG_SW=n`）仍不可用
416: 
417: 15 帧中 11 帧坏。判据：好帧 entropy=884（`comlen=277`），坏帧 entropy=868（`comlen=261`），差 16 字节；坏帧声明的 entropy 起点处残留硬件 SOS 字节（`11 00 3f 00`、`00 0c 03 01 …`）被当画面解码。
418: 
419: 根因：硬件确实输出自己的 SOS（与 `camera.md` §14.6 相反），但其前的 `0xFF` 填充长度逐帧变化，而 `write_header()` 以「第一个非 FF 字节」判头结束。
420: 
421: 已修两处并通过桌面单测（新增 `test_write_header_entropy_starts_with_ff`、`test_write_header_consumes_shifted_sos`）：marker 白名单（修前 entropy 685→17136）、前向扫描吃掉硬件 SOS。**修复后的 15 帧复测未完成，暂勿依赖该配置。**
422: 
423: ### 10.4 第三条取回路径：`agent_camera tcp=<ip>:<port>`
424: 
425: 裸 JPEG、一帧一连接、关闭即分帧；主机用 `tools/tcpframes.py OUTDIR [PORT] [COUNT]` 或 `nc -l -p 5000 > f.jpg`。控制台地板 4.3 s/帧（11.5KB/s，base64 36KB→49KB），5fps 640x480 需 125KB/s，控制台达不到。
426: 
427: **吞吐未实测**：AIPC(192.168.31.x) 到公司网主机 `ENETUNREACH(101)`；MIPublic(10.192.105.x) 有路由但 `ETIMEDOUT(110)`，同时主机 `0.0.0.0:5000` 确认 LISTEN 且自连成功。需接收端与板子同网段且不拦 TCP 出口。
428: 
429: ### 10.5 配网判据：新增第五个陷阱
430: 
431: - **新增**：MIPublic 这类网络拦 TCP 出口但放行 DNS/ICMP。`ping` 通、`net_status: yes`，而 `net_test` 报 `net_connect ... ret=0x52`（`MBEDTLS_ERR_NET_CONNECT_FAILED`）。判连通只能用 `net_test` 的 `Handshake OK` + `HTTP Status: 200`。
432: - **修正**：ICMP 并非所有网络都屏蔽。AIPC 实测 `ping -c 2 www.baidu.com` 解析 `153.3.238.127`、9.0/23.0 ms、0% 丢包。「ping 不通」不证明网坏，「ping 通」不证明 TCP 可用。
433: 
434: 关联参照：`wapi psk wlan0 <密码> 3`、`wapi essid wlan0 AIPC 1`、`renew wlan0`（第一次必失败报 `netlib_obtain_ipv4addr() failed`，第二次成功），`ifconfig wlan0` 显示 `RUNNING` 且 `192.168.31.30`。

19:  * ------
20:  * One 4KB sector holds the whole store, rewritten as a unit:
21:  *
22:  *   magic "VKVDB\0\0\0" | version | count | crc32 of the record area

30:  * leaving it erased means a half-written sector can never look valid.

    The store's flash backend reached across to the CP: it drove the vendor's
    flash server over the mailbox, which made this project depend on the
    protocol of four CP-side files it does not own -- flash_server.c,
    flash_notify.c, flash_ipc.h and flash_partition.c -- and it needed the
    mailbox transport changed to carry the transaction.  So the client goes.
    
    Removed with it: bk7258_flash_client.c and its header, the erase/write/read
    path in bk7258_kvdb.c, the FLASH RX channel registration in the mailbox
    transport, bk7258_flash_notify_init() from bring-up, CONFIG_BK7258_KVDB_FLASH
    and the =y it had in the ai_agent defconfig.  Nothing else about the mailbox
    is touched: the IPC channel, the acknowledgement header and the "a single
    unanswered message is not a dead link" timeout all stay.
    
    The store itself stays and is honest about what it is.  `kvdb set` answers
    "stored for this boot only (flash backend disabled)",
    bk7258_kvdb_persistent() returns false, and kvdb_loader still seeds the
    agent's config file and brings Wi-Fi up from whatever was typed this boot.
    That seed call no longer hangs off a successful load, which after this change
    never happens.

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/src/bk7258_gc9d01_fb.c
3:  *
4:  * openvela framebuffer driver for the GC9D01 panels (160x160 round, RGB565,
5:  * one per QSPI controller).  Implements the three hooks fb_register() needs
6:  * -- up_fbinitialize(), up_fbgetvplane(), up_fbuninitialize() -- plus the
7:  * fb_vtable_s entries required for a panel that has no autonomous refresh:
8:  * getvideoinfo, getplaneinfo and updatearea.
9:  *
10:  * Why updatearea is mandatory here: a RAM-less RGB parallel panel is
11:  * scanned out continuously by an LCD controller, so writing the
12:  * framebuffer is enough.  GC9D01 has its own GRAM and is written over a
13:  * serial bus, so nothing reaches the glass until the driver explicitly
14:  * pushes it.  Without CONFIG_FB_UPDATE + this callback the screen would
15:  * simply never change.
16:  *
17:  * ---------------------------------------------------------------------
18:  * Multiple displays
19:  * ---------------------------------------------------------------------
20:  * fb_register(display, plane) (include/nuttx/video/fb.h) calls
21:  * up_fbinitialize(display), then up_fbgetvplane(display, plane), then
22:  * fb_register_device(), which names the node /dev/fb<display>.  So exposing
23:  * two panels is just a matter of calling fb_register() twice.
24:  *
25:  * The constraint that shapes this file: fb_vtable_s's callbacks receive
26:  * only the vtable pointer, with no display argument.  A single shared
27:  * vtable therefore cannot tell which panel it is being asked about.  Each
28:  * display consequently gets its own state structure whose *first* member is
29:  * the vtable, so a callback can recover its own state by casting the vtable
30:  * pointer back (the usual container-of trick, valid here because the vtable
31:  * sits at offset 0).
32:  *
33:  * Framebuffers come from the kernel heap: 2 x 51200 = 100KB out of roughly
34:  * 300KB, which is affordable and much faster for the CPU to write than
35:  * PSRAM (which is mapped non-cacheable).  The camera's own frame buffers do
36:  * live in PSRAM -- they are 614400 bytes each and have no alternative.
37:  *
38:  * The panels are round: the corners of the 160x160 square are not visible.
39:  * That is a composition concern for whatever draws into the framebuffer,

<thinking>**Quantifying causes and answer no modifications**原因已经明确，主要不是按键 GPIO 或去抖本身，而是**最新版本把每次按键响应变成了双屏同步全帧刷新，且每次全帧刷新都会同步阻塞在两块 GC9D01 面板的 SPI 传输上**。

**第一主因：按键事件路径同步刷新双屏整帧**

当前按键处理路径是：

```text
vs_input_poll()
-> vs_handle_event()
-> vs_acknowledge()
-> vs_render()
-> vs_display_render()
-> LVGL 刷新 fb0
-> FBIO_UPDATE
-> GC9D01 整帧 push 51200 bytes
-> LVGL 刷新 fb1
-> FBIO_UPDATE
-> GC9D01 整帧 push 51200 bytes
-> 返回按键处理循环
```

关键代码：

```text
app/velasight/vs_app.c:930
vs_acknowledge(display, runtime, event->key);
```

```text
app/velasight/vs_app.c:576
vs_render(display, runtime);
```

```text
app/velasight/vs_display.c:510
vs_render_content(...)
vs_render_status(...)
```

```text
app/velasight/vs_display.c:521-522
lv_refr_now(fb0);
lv_refr_now(fb1);
```

GC9D01 驱动中，`FBIO_UPDATE` 最终会调用：

```text
gc9d01_updatearea()
-> gc9d01_push()
-> bk7258_lcd_spi_write_frame(..., 51200)
```

代码位置：

```text
board/.../bk7258_gc9d01_fb.c:235
board/.../bk7258_gc9d01_fb.c:193
board/.../bk7258_gc9d01_fb.c:207
```

而且当前驱动明确忽略 LVGL 的局部更新区域：

```c
UNUSED(area);
return gc9d01_push(...);
```

也就是说，即使按键只改变了一个文字或一个高亮状态，仍然会把整块 `160x160 RGB565` framebuffer 发送到屏幕。

每次按键响应至少要进行：

```text
51200 bytes fb0
+
51200 bytes fb1
```

这会直接阻塞事件循环。

**第二主因：每个短按额外阻塞 120 ms**

当前短按处理还明确加入了：

```c
usleep(120000);
```

位置：

```text
app/velasight/vs_app.c:577
```

流程是：

```c
vs_set_response(runtime, key);
vs_render(display, runtime);
usleep(120000);
runtime->response_ticks = 0;
```

因此每次短按都至少有：

```text
一次同步双屏刷新
+ 120 ms 睡眠
```

在这个 `usleep(120000)` 期间：

- 不会轮询按键
- 不会处理下一次输入
- 不会处理应用事件
- 不会正常执行主循环中的 LVGL handler
- 用户会感觉按键迟钝或“按了没立即反应”

这应该是当前“按键后响应变慢”最直接的用户可感知原因之一。

**第三主因：按键循环本身仍有 10 ms 固定轮询间隔**

主循环末尾：

```c
usleep(CONFIG_VS_INPUT_POLL_MS * 1000);
```

当前配置通常是：

```text
CONFIG_VS_INPUT_POLL_MS=10
```

单独看 10 ms 不严重，但它叠加在：

```text
120 ms acknowledge 延时
+
双屏整帧 SPI push
+
LVGL 软件绘制
```

之后，就会明显降低输入响应速度。

**第四主因：动画帧率被双屏同步全帧提交限制**

当前每帧都要经过：

```text
LVGL 软件绘制
-> fb0 整帧 push
-> fb1 整帧 push
```

因此动画帧率上限取决于：

```text
LVGL CPU 绘制耗时
+
第一块 GC9D01 SPI 传输耗时
+
第二块 GC9D01 SPI 传输耗时
```

而不是 LVGL timer 的理论频率。

驱动中的注释已经确认：

```text
panel takes no partial update
the push dominates and sets the pace
```

位置：

```text
board/.../bk7258_gc9d01_fb.c:463-470
```

所以动画帧率降低是必然结果。尤其当前 UI 刷新一个页面时，左右两块屏幕都参与提交，即使只有一侧屏幕实际内容变化，也会刷新两块屏幕。

**第五主因：新增图标绘制本身增加了 LVGL 绘制负担**

最近新增的主页状态图标使用 LVGL draw API：

```text
lv_draw_arc()
lv_draw_line()
```

位置：

```text
app/velasight/vs_display.c:128-219
```

Wi-Fi 图标每次绘制包含：

```text
2 个弧线
1 个圆点
```

电池图标包含：

```text
4 条线
```

API 图标包含：

```text
3 条线
```

这些图标相对于文字很小，不是最大瓶颈，但它们属于 LVGL 绘制阶段，会增加每次 framebuffer 重绘的 CPU 工作量。重要的是，图标对象仍然位于完整 LVGL screen 树中，主页被重新渲染时会参与整屏刷新。

因此它会加重：

```text
CPU 绘制时间
+
整帧提交时间
```

但从影响排序看，图标绘制开销低于同步 SPI 整帧提交和 `120 ms` 阻塞。

**第六主因：每次按键还会刷新两个 screen 的所有内容**

`vs_display_render()` 每次调用都会执行：

```c
vs_render_content(...);
vs_render_status(...);
```

随后，LVGL framebuffer backend 的 flush 会把 dirty area 合并后提交给驱动。

但 GC9D01 驱动的实际行为是：

```c
UNUSED(area);
return gc9d01_push(...);
```

所以最终效果是：

```text
局部 dirty area
-> 被驱动丢弃
-> 仍然整屏 push
```

这使得以下操作成本几乎相同：

```text
改变一个按键高亮
切换一个页面
更新进度环
刷新等待动画
更新主页图标状态
```

全部会触发完整屏幕传输。

**当前版本相对于原版本的关键性能变化**

最新版本引入或强化了以下开销：

1. 从简单的单次 `lv_timer_handler()`，变成了页面状态变化后的双屏 LVGL 重绘。
2. 首帧逻辑增加了 `lv_refr_now()`，虽然只执行一次，不是持续卡顿主因。
3. 每次按键响应增加了 `vs_acknowledge()`。
4. 每次按键响应固定 `usleep(120000)`。
5. 每次按键触发左右两块屏幕内容同步更新。
6. 新增 LVGL 自定义图标绘制。
7. GC9D01 framebuffer backend 仍然对每个 update 做整帧 SPI push。
8. 等待状态由 `vs_display_tick()` 持续调用 `lv_timer_handler()`，动画也会占用同一个 UI 线程。

**不是主要原因的部分**

以下部分暂时不是主要瓶颈：

- `vs_input_poll()` 的按键去抖逻辑
- 10 ms 按键轮询周期本身
- Wi-Fi worker 线程
- `bk7258_ai_config_ready()` 读取配置
- API key 状态判断
- `vs_snapshot()` 的字符串构造
- 主页三个图标的内存分配

这些会有少量开销，但不会解释明显的按键迟滞和动画帧率下降。

**最终结论**

性能问题的主要链路是：

```text
按键事件
-> 同步刷新双屏
-> 每块屏幕都整帧发送 51200 bytes
-> SPI 传输阻塞 UI 线程
-> 额外 sleep 120 ms
-> 主循环无法及时继续轮询
```

优先级排序：

```text
1. GC9D01 updatearea 忽略局部区域，任何刷新都整帧 push
2. 按键 acknowledge 固定阻塞 120 ms
3. 一次 UI 事件同步刷新两块屏幕
4. 等待/动画与输入共享同一 UI 线程
5. 新增 LVGL 自定义图标增加绘制负担
6. 10 ms 主循环 sleep 是次要影响
```

因此当前版本的症状是符合代码行为的，不是偶发故障。

本次只做了代码分析，没有修改任何文件。

368: /****************************************************************************
369:  * Name: lcd_xfer_fifo
370:  *
371:  * Description:
372:  *   Shifts out the first 4 bytes through cmd_c_h and the next 'fifo_len'
373:  *   bytes through the TX FIFO, as
374:  *   lcd_spi_send_data_with_qspi_indirect_mode()'s long branch does.  Bytes
375:  *   are assembled one at a time so an unaligned source pointer is safe (a
376:  *   command table entry's payload generally is not word aligned).
377:  *
378:  ****************************************************************************/
379: 
380: static bool lcd_xfer_fifo(FAR struct lcd_bus_s *b, const uint8_t *data,
381:                           uint32_t fifo_len)
382: {
383:   uint32_t words = (fifo_len + 3u) / 4u;
384:   uint32_t value;
385:   uint32_t i;
386: 
387:   value = ((uint32_t)data[0]) |
388:           ((uint32_t)data[1] << 8) |
389:           ((uint32_t)data[2] << 16) |
390:           ((uint32_t)data[3] << 24);
391: 
392:   putreg32(value, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_H);
393:   putreg32(QSPI_CFG1_FIFO_PAYLOAD, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG1);
394:   putreg32(fifo_len << QSPI_CFG2_DATA_LEN_SHIFT,
395:            b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG2);
396: 
397:   for (i = 0; i < words; i++)
398:     {
399:       uint32_t word = 0;
400:       uint32_t k;
401: 
402:       for (k = 0; k < 4u; k++)
403:         {
404:           uint32_t idx = i * 4u + k;
405: 
406:           if (idx < fifo_len)
407:             {
408:               word |= ((uint32_t)data[4u + idx]) << (k * 8);
409:             }
410:         }
411: 
412:       putreg32(word, b->base + QSPI_OFF_FIFO_DATA + i * 4u);
413:     }
414: 
415:   modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG2, 0, QSPI_CMD_START_BIT);
416: 
417:   return lcd_wait_done(b);
418: }

421:                      uint32_t len)
422: {
423:   uint32_t remain = len;
424:   const uint8_t *p = data;
425: 
426:   while (remain > 0)
427:     {
428:       uint32_t fifo_len;
429: 
430:       if (remain <= 4u)
431:         {
432:           return lcd_xfer_short(b, p, remain);
433:         }
434: 
435:       fifo_len = remain - 4u;
436:       if (fifo_len > QSPI_FIFO_MAX_BYTES)
437:         {
438:           fifo_len = QSPI_FIFO_MAX_BYTES;
439:         }
440: 
441:       if (!lcd_xfer_fifo(b, p, fifo_len))
442:         {
443:           return false;
444:         }
445: 
446:       p += 4u + fifo_len;
447:       remain -= 4u + fifo_len;
448:     }
449: 
450:   return true;
451: }

578: bool bk7258_lcd_spi_write_frame(int bus, const void *frame, size_t len)
579: {
580:   FAR struct lcd_bus_s *b = lcd_bus(bus);
581:   const uint32_t *src = frame;
582:   size_t words = len / 4u;
583:   size_t i;
584: 
585:   if (b == NULL || !b->initialized || frame == NULL || len == 0 ||
586:       (len & 3u) != 0)
587:     {
588:       return false;
589:     }
590: 
591:   /* RAMWR goes out as an ordinary DC-low command; CS is allowed to
592:    * deassert afterwards, exactly as bk_lcd_spi_frame_display() does.
593:    */
594: 
595:   if (!bk7258_lcd_spi_write_cmd(bus, GC9D01_CMD_RAMWR))
596:     {
597:       return false;
598:     }
599: 
600:   bk7258_gpio_write(b->dc_pin, true);
601: 
602:   /* lcd_spi_quad_write_start(): park the command channel, hold CS low for
603:    * the whole burst, hand the data line to the memory-mapped window and
604:    * stop the command path from generating SCK.
605:    */
606: 
607:   putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_L);
608:   putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_H);
609:   putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG1);
610:   putreg32(0, b->base + QSPI_OFF_CMD_C_CFG2);
611: 
612:   modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, 0, QSPI_CONFIG_FORCE_SPI_CS_LOW);
613:   modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, 0, QSPI_CONFIG_IO_CPU_MEM_SEL);
614:   modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, 0, QSPI_CONFIG_DISABLE_CMD_SCK);
615: 
616:   if (b->frames < 2)
617:     {
618:       printf("bk7258_lcd_spi[%s]: frame %u: config=0x%08x words=%u "
619:              "src=%p first_px=0x%04x swap=%u\n", b->name,
620:              (unsigned int)b->frames,
621:              (unsigned int)getreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG),
622:              (unsigned int)words, frame,
623:              (unsigned int)(src[0] & 0xffff),
624:              (unsigned int)g_swap_bytes);
625:     }
626: 
627:   /* CPU-driven copy.  The controller back-pressures the AHB write when its
628:    * FIFO is full, so this self-throttles to the wire rate; 160x160 RGB565
629:    * measured ~27ms on the bus.
630:    *
631:    * The destination address increments: lcd_spi_dma_single_mode_config()
632:    * sets dst.start_addr = qspi_data, dst.end_addr = qspi_data + data_len
633:    * and dst.addr_inc_en = DMA_ADDR_INC_ENABLE, so the window is a range,
634:    * not a single FIFO register.
635:    */
636: 
637:   if (g_swap_bytes)
638:     {
639:       for (i = 0; i < words; i++)
640:         {
641:           putreg32(gc9_swap16x2(src[i]), b->window + i * 4u);
642:         }
643:     }
644:   else
645:     {
646:       for (i = 0; i < words; i++)
647:         {
648:           putreg32(src[i], b->window + i * 4u);
649:         }
650:     }
651: 
652:   up_udelay(QSPI_FRAME_TAIL_DELAY_US);
653: 
654:   /* lcd_spi_quad_write_stop(), same order as the reference. */
655: 
656:   modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, QSPI_CONFIG_DISABLE_CMD_SCK, 0);
657:   modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, QSPI_CONFIG_FORCE_SPI_CS_LOW, 0);
658:   modifyreg32(b->base + QSPI_OFF_CONFIG, QSPI_CONFIG_IO_CPU_MEM_SEL, 0);
659: 
660:   b->frames++;
